headline: Ether Long-To-Short Ratio Rises 0.42 To 2.31, Reaching The 91.1 Percentile Of Its 30-Day Range
narrative: The Ether long-to-short ratio rose 0.42 over 24 hours to 2.31, and 0.81 over seven days, placing the reading at the 91.1 percentile of its own 30-day range. Bitcoin's ratio rose 0.32 over 24 hours to 1.76, the 91.0 percentile of its 30-day range, a gain of 0.55 over seven days. A reading above 1 means the long side outnumbers the short side, so leveraged money in both pipes is concentrated on the long side of the past month's range.
author: jordan
